content_sections.heading: IIT Kanpur Project Associate Recruitment 2026 Overview
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the age limit or the application fee.

content_sections.heading: About IIT Kanpur National Aerosol Facility
content_sections.text: The National Aerosol Facility is a unit of the Indian Institute of Technology Kanpur, coordinated by Prof. Sachchida Nand Tripathi. This project post is based in Ahmedabad, where the work covers air quality and environmental monitoring, data analysis and GIS work. Details of the group are on its page at iitk.ac.in/atman.

content_sections.heading: IIT Kanpur Project Associate Vacancy Details 2026
content_sections.text: The pay scale starts at INR 21,600 and goes up to INR 54,000 per month. It is a consolidated amount, and the notice says it shall be commensurate with experience and skills. content_sections.heading: IIT Kanpur Project Associate Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: Post graduate degree in environmental science/ engineering, atmospheric science, climate studies, or a closely related field. Basic proficiency in the MS Productivity Suite, including MS Word, Excel and PowerPoint. Working knowledge of Python or R for scientific and environmental data processing and analysis. Basic working knowledge of ArcGIS or QGIS for spatial data processing and visualization. Basic understanding of air quality monitoring, atmospheric/environmental data and scientific measurements. Good analytical, problem-solving and communication skills, with attention to detail. Ability to work both independently and as part of a team. For the full eligibility conditions of the post, see the official notification.

content_sections.heading: Duties and Responsibilities
content_sections.text: Provide scientific and administrative support to the project manager, project executive officer, post-doctoral fellows and project team. Assist in air-quality and environmental monitoring, including field deployment, data collection and monitoring of sensors and scientific instruments. Process, clean, analyse and quality check scientific and environmental data, and present trends and patterns through graphs, charts, tables and reports. Assist in statistical, time series and QA/QC analysis, including identification of trends, patterns and pollution hotspots. Assist in GIS-based processing and visualization of environmental and spatial datasets using ArcGIS/QGIS. Conduct literature reviews and help prepare technical reports, handbooks, policy documents and other project deliverables. Maintain organised records of project data, field activities, equipment and instruments, observations, reports and other technical documentation. Undertake other project-related scientific, technical or administrative tasks as assigned.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: The department reserves the right to fix suitable criteria for shortlisting eligible candidates who meet the qualification and experience. Selection will be based on interviews, held online and/or in person. Shortlisted candidates will be informed of the interview date by email.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: Nature of position: Temporary / Contractual. Duration: 1 year or till the end of the project, whichever is earlier, renewed annually based on performance. Place of posting: Ahmedabad, Gujarat. The selected candidate must work in Ahmedabad as the project requires. Accommodation: the selected candidate must arrange their own accommodation in Ahmedabad.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IIT Kanpur Project Associate Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Mandatory information to send: Resume/CV Cover letter explaining your suitability for the position Contact information of 2 references Writing samples (published or unpublished)

faq.question: Q1. How many Project Associate posts has IIT Kanpur advertised?
faq.answer: One post, under advertisement number P.Rect./R&D/2026/219, at the National Aerosol Facility.

faq.question: Q2. Where will the Project Associate be posted?
faq.answer: The post is based in Ahmedabad, Gujarat. The selected candidate must arrange their own accommodation there.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is required?
faq.answer: A postgraduate degree in environmental science/engineering, atmospheric science, climate studies or a closely related field.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary of the IIT Kanpur Project Associate?
faq.answer: INR 21,600 to INR 54,000 per month consolidated, fixed according to experience and skills.

faq.question: Q5. Which software skills are preferred?
faq.answer: MS Word, Excel and PowerPoint, Python or R for data analysis, and ArcGIS or QGIS for spatial data are desirable.

faq.question: Q6. How long is the appointment?
faq.answer: It is temporary and contractual for 1 year or till the project ends, whichever is earlier, and is renewed annually based on performance.

faq.question: Q7. What should the email subject line contain?
faq.answer: It should contain the post applied for and the advertisement number, P.Rect./R&D/2026/219.

faq.question: Q8. What documents must be sent with the application?
faq.answer: A resume/CV, a cover letter on your suitability, contact information of 2 references, and published or unpublished writing samples.

faq.question: Q9. How will candidates be selected?
faq.answer: Shortlisted candidates will be interviewed online and/or in person. The interview date will be sent to them by email.
